description: How ISO 23537 Comfort, Limit and Extreme ratings work, why they vary by sleeper, and how to pick a bag rating for the coldest night you expect.
directAnswer: Under ISO 23537 a bag has three numbers: Comfort for a cold sleeper, Limit for a warm sleeper curled up, and Extreme as a survival figure. Plan around the Comfort rating, add a margin, and pair the bag with a pad that suits the night.
